title: qdb-benchmark: code and data artifact for "Security evaluation of quantum distance-bounding protocols via semidefinite programming"
description: Builds the paper's reduced one-round fast-phase games as semidefinite programs, solves the distance-fraud and mafia-fraud programs for the discrete-variable QDB protocols, runs the restricted Gaussian finite-grid estimator for the CV-QDB protocol, and checks the shipped mafia-fraud certificates with a solver-independent NumPy checker.
